faqs.question: Can I mount the HydroCoil reel onto vinyl siding without hitting a wood stud?
faqs.answer: No. Loaded with water the unit weighs over 35 pounds and experiences pulling torque—always anchor at least two lag bolts directly into a solid wood framing stud, 4x4 fence post, or brick masonry.

faqs.question: Does the hose whip back dangerously if my hand slips?
faqs.answer: No. An integrated centrifugal rewind governor brakes retraction down to a gentle walking speed so you can guide the brass nozzle safely back to the housing.

faqs.question: Can I lock the hose halfway down the yard without holding tension?
faqs.answer: Yes! Pull out the exact length you need (whether 15 ft or all 100 ft) and pause slightly—the internal ratchet locks firmly until you give a quick short tug to retract.

faqs.question: How do I protect it during freezing winters?
faqs.answer: Turn off your exterior spigot, squeeze the spray nozzle to drain pressure, lift out the vertical wall-bracket pin, and carry the reel indoors to a garage or basement.
